title: Iran’s Pezeshkian Writes Tribute to Minab Children at India Exhibition
text:
"Iran’s Pezeshkian Writes Tribute to Minab Children at India Exhibition"

"At an exhibition in India held in memory of the children of Minab, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian wrote a message on a memorial board where visitors had left handwritten tributes in their memory, and talks about it for the Iran's State TV reporter."

"======"

"SOT, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(00:18 - 00:34): "The world, with the self-proclaimed advocates of democracy and the demonic criminals who claim to stand for humanity and democracy, but in reality are the most savage and criminal living beings on Earth.
